Questions 26–30

What does the tutor suggest doing with Jack's research regarding each of the following tasks?

Write the correct letter, A-E, next to Questions 26-30.

28 do research on ingredients of well-done beef

Suggestions
A do it with a partner
B not worthy of doing
C leave it to others
D do it later
E need special training beforehand

transcript.en: Jack, how is your research into food additives and ingredients going?
transcript.zh: 杰克，你对食品添加剂和成分的研究进展如何？

transcript.en: My project is going well, although I haven’t quite finished.
transcript.zh: 虽然还没有完成，但进展顺利。

transcript.en: There are a few remaining points I need to research, and some data to compile.
transcript.zh: 还有一些我需要研究的部分，还有一些数据需要编译。

transcript.en: I’m happy to hear it’s coming along well.
transcript.zh: 很高兴知道你的研究进展顺利。

transcript.en: I understand you collaborated with a partner on some aspects of this project.
transcript.zh: 我了解到你在该项目的某些方面是与合作者进行了合作的。

transcript.en: Sometimes it’s worth teaming up with a fellow student, especially if you’ve worked together before and you know you can perform well as a team.
transcript.zh: 有时，与同学合作是值得的，特别是当你们以前一起合作过，知道你们作为团队会有出色表现。

transcript.en: Originally, I thought the research material would be complicated, so I should ask a friend to help interpret the results, however, it was not as complicated as I imagined.
transcript.zh: 我本来以为研究材料会很复杂，所以应该请朋友帮忙解读一下结果，结果并没有想象中那么复杂。

transcript.en: But it turned out having a partner was beneficial, because there was a lot of research that needed doing, and I won’t have had the time to do it on my own.
transcript.zh: 但事实证明，有一个合作者是有好处的，因为需要做很多研究，而我自己一个人没有足够时间去做。

transcript.en: It’s usually of benefit when conducting a research project to interview people that deal with your topic of study regularly.
transcript.zh: 在进行研究项目时，定期采访你研究主题相关人员通常是有益的。

transcript.en: Have you thought about who you could include in your interviewing process?
transcript.zh: 你有没有想过你可以面试谁？

transcript.en: Perhaps supermarket managers would be a good starting point.
transcript.zh: 也许可以从超市经理开始。

transcript.en: Yeah, it’s true that supermarket managers could be important subjects for a survey like this, but I have decided to start with consumers, and take down their opinions on what they’re eating.
transcript.zh: 是的，超市经理确实可以成为此类调查的重要受测对象，但我决定从消费者开始，记录他们对所吃食物的看法。

transcript.en: Then what I am going to do is to conduct some surveys with food manufacturers.
transcript.zh: 然后我要做的就是对食品厂家做一些调查。

transcript.en: It’s also necessary to know what food manufacturers think of.
transcript.zh: 也有必要知道食品厂商的想法。

transcript.en: Excellent. Just remember, you will have to get permission from Management before you begin.
transcript.zh: 太好了。请记住，你必须先获得管理层的许可。

transcript.en: What information have you found useful for your project so far?
transcript.zh: 到目前为止，你发现哪些信息对你的项目有用？

transcript.en: I’ve been examining labels on frequently purchased products, especially ready-made meals, to understand what manufacturers are required to disclose.
transcript.zh: 我一直在检查经常购买的产品标签，尤其是即食食品的标签，以了解制造商被要求披露的内容。

transcript.en: I found the results interesting. I thought the weight of the product and ingredients would have to be stated on the packaging.
transcript.zh: 我发现结果很有趣。我原以为包装上必须注明产品和成分的重量。

transcript.en: What did you find instead?
transcript.zh: 你发现了什么？

transcript.en: It seems the price of the food item is the most important consideration of the manufacturers, rather than the consumers’ awareness of what they’re eating.
transcript.zh: 似乎食品的价格是制造商考量最多的因素，而不是消费者对他们吃的东西的了解程度。

transcript.en: Regarding food items that contained a list of ingredients, was there anything you found particularly surprising, such as which foods are most popular?
transcript.zh: 关于包含成分列表的食物，你有没有发现特别令人惊讶的事情，比如哪些食物最受欢迎？

transcript.en: Unfortunately, I couldn’t find out much about the popularity of foods from the labels, although I suspect the most frequently bought items would be from the fast-food aisle!
transcript.zh: 不幸的是，我无法从标签上找到关于食品受欢迎程度的信息，尽管我怀疑最常购买的商品来自快餐食品区！

transcript.en: What really surprised me was the amount of artificial ingredients these foods contain.
transcript.zh: 真正让我吃惊的是这些食物中含有大量人造成分。

transcript.en: We’re taking in vast amounts of additives every day!
transcript.zh: 我们每天都在摄入大量的添加剂！

transcript.en: As the cost of food goes up, we’ll see additives listed in the ingredients more often, as it’s cheaper to produce chemicals than grow the natural products.
transcript.zh: 随着食品成本的上涨，我们会看到成分列表中列出的添加剂越来越多，因为生产化学品比种植天然产品更便宜。

transcript.en: Do you have any concerns over how your project is going? Is it hard to get respondents?
transcript.zh: 你对项目进展情况有担忧吗？调查对象难找吗？

transcript.en: That’s the easy part! My partner on the project worries that we have much more essential data to collect.
transcript.zh: 不难！我的项目合作者担心我们需要收集更多重要数据。

transcript.en: But I’m more concerned with the fact that we’re running out of time to complete the project.
transcript.zh: 但我更担心的是我们已经没有足够时间完成这个项目了。

transcript.en: I have some tips to assist you. You must have a great deal of recorded content to interpret.
transcript.zh: 我有一些建议可以帮到你。你必须有大量的录制内容，对这些录制内容进行解析。

transcript.en: It may be difficult to compile, so continuing to work with your partner is a good option.
transcript.zh: 可能很难编译，所以继续和你的合作伙伴一起完成是一个不错的选择。

transcript.en: Those hand-held recorders worked really well.
transcript.zh: 手持录音机很好用。

transcript.en: I think I’ll use them again for interviewing next time.
transcript.zh: 我想下次我还会用它们来作访问。

transcript.en: I’ve also got to collect some data specific to consumer preferences.
transcript.zh: 我还必须收集一些针对消费者偏好的数据。

transcript.en: It’s difficult to find the time.
transcript.zh: 好难找时间。

transcript.en: There’s no harm in asking someone else to collect it, and even analyse it. You just need the results.
transcript.zh: 让别人收集它，甚至分析它是没有坏处的。你只需要结果。

transcript.en: Some of the first-year students would be glad to have the experience.
transcript.zh: 一些大一学生会很高兴有这样的经验。

transcript.en: That would be fantastic! I’ve got some specific research to do on the ingredients of well-done beef. It’s a controversial issue.
transcript.zh: 那太棒了！我要对熟牛肉的成分进行一些具体的研究。这是一个有争议的问题。

transcript.en: Perhaps you could read some articles on the subject beforehand, although there is not much information available.
transcript.zh: 也许你可以事先阅读一些关于这个主题的文章，虽然没有太多可用的信息。

transcript.en: I understand why you want to include this in your project, but I think you need to weigh up its worth against the time it would take. It wouldn’t be worth it.
transcript.zh: 我理解你为什么要将它加到你的项目中，但我认为你需要权衡它的价值和它所花费的时间。这不值得。

transcript.en: True. I still have those interviews in the shopping centre to conduct.
transcript.zh: 是的。我还要在购物中心做一些采访。

transcript.en: I suggest before you begin that you do some training.
transcript.zh: 我建议你在开始之前进行一些训练。

transcript.en: Most shopping centre managers want interviewers to act professionally, so you might need to find out some specific information first.
transcript.zh: 大多数购物中心的经理都希望面试官表现得专业，所以你可能需要先找到一些具体信息。

transcript.en: You don’t want to harass customers.
transcript.zh: 你当然不想骚扰顾客。

transcript.en: Ok, I’ll think about that. I’ve also got to decide on the layout of the results and format it into a logical presentation.
transcript.zh: 好的，我考虑一下。我还必须决定好结果的结构并编辑格式，做成一个有逻辑的演示。

transcript.en: You can work on that once you’ve gathered all your data.
transcript.zh: 一旦你收集了所有的数据，你就可以开始做这件事了。

transcript.en: Great, thanks for your help!
transcript.zh: 太好了，谢谢您的帮助！
